The animal typically regarded as man's best friend is the dog.

OmniFit’s introduction of a subscription model for fitness equipment represents a significant shift in the industry, moving from a transactional sales model to a recurring revenue model. This strategy lowers the barrier to entry for consumers by eliminating large upfront costs and offering the flexibility to upgrade to newer technology regularly. For your business, this creates substantial competitive pressure. If customers begin to value flexibility and access over ownership, your current sales model may appear less attractive. To retain customer loyalty and stay relevant, you should seriously consider developing a similar subscription or leasing option, or alternatively, emphasize the long-term value, durability, and resale value of owned equipment to differentiate your brand. Ignoring this trend risks losing market share to competitors who offer greater convenience and adaptability.
